title: Lord I Lift Your Name
lyrics_original: Lord I lift Your name on high
Lord I love to sing Your praises
I'm so glad You're in my life
I'm so glad You came to save us
You came from heaven to earth – To show the way
From the earth to the cross – My debt to pay
From the cross to the grave
From the grave to the sky
Lord I lift Your name on high

bible_verses.telugu: మరియు, ఆయన  ఆకారమందు  మనుష్యుడుగా  కనబడి, మరణము పొందునంతగా, అనగా సిలువమరణము పొందు నంతగా విధేయత చూపినవాడై, తన్నుతాను తగ్గించుకొనెను. అందుచేతను పరలోకమందున్నవారిలో గాని, భూమిమీద ఉన్నవారిలో గాని,
bible_verses.english: And being found in appearance as a man, he humbled himself by becoming obedient to death—even death on a cross! Therefore God exalted him to the highest place and gave him the name that is above every name.

bible_verses.telugu: నేను తండ్రియొద్దనుండి బయలుదేరి లోకమునకు వచ్చియున్నాను; మరియు లోకమును విడిచి తండ్రియొద్దకు వెళ్లుచున్నానని వారితో చెప్పెను.
bible_verses.english: I came from the Father and entered the world; now I am leaving the world and going back to the Father.

bible_verses.telugu: దేవుడు వ్రాతరూపకమైన ఆజ్ఞలవలన మనమీద ఋణముగాను మనకు విరోధముగాను నుండిన పత్రమును మేకులతో సిలువకు కొట్టి, దానిమీది చేవ్రాతను తుడిచివేసి,మనకు అడ్డములేకుండ దానిని ఎత్తి వేసి మన అపరాధములనన్నిటిని క్షమించి,
bible_verses.english: having canceled the charge of our legal indebtedness, which stood against us and condemned us; he has taken it away, nailing it to the cross.

devotional.prayer_english: Lord Jesus, thank You for coming from heaven to earth just to show us the way to the Father. I am so grateful that You bore my debt upon the cross and rose in victory over death. Today, I lift Your name high above every concern and distraction in my life. Fill my heart with joy as I sing Your praises, and help me live in the light of Your amazing grace. Amen.
devotional.prayer_original: Lord Jesus, thank You for coming from heaven to earth just to show us the way to the Father. I am so grateful that You bore my debt upon the cross and rose in victory over death. Today, I lift Your name high above every concern and distraction in my life. Fill my heart with joy as I sing Your praises, and help me live in the light of Your amazing grace. Amen.
devotional.reflection_english: This beloved song traces the beautiful trajectory of Jesus’ love—from the glory of heaven to the humility of the cross, and ultimately to His victorious resurrection. He walked this path not out of obligation, but to make a way for us to be reconnected with God and freed from our debt. As we sing these words, we are invited to pause and marvel at such self-giving grace. Lifting His name is our joyful, heartfelt response to the Savior who gave everything for us.
